questions.stem: Which tissue type covers exterior body surfaces and lines hollow internal visceral organs?
The basement membrane supporting epithelial cells consists of basal lamina and:
questions.explanation: Basement membrane = Basal lamina + Reticular lamina.

questions.stem: Which simple epithelium is composed of a single layer of flattened pavement-like cells?
questions.explanation: Simple squamous epithelium features flat pavement cells.

questions.stem: Microvilli lining the PCT of renal nephrons form a brush border to:
options: B) Maximize surface area for selective reabsorption
questions.answer: B) Maximize surface area for selective reabsorption
questions.explanation: Brush border microvilli increase absorption surface area.

questions.stem: Goblet cells interspersed in simple columnar gut epithelium function to secrete:
questions.explanation: Goblet cells are unicellular exocrine glands secreting mucus.

questions.stem: Which epithelial modification propels trapped particles along the respiratory tract mucosa?
questions.explanation: Motile cilia move mucus sweeps in respiratory passages.

questions.stem: Non-keratinized stratified squamous epithelium lines which moist anatomical site?
questions.explanation: Non-keratinized stratified squamous protects moist surfaces like mouth.

questions.stem: The distensible plastic epithelium lining the lumen of the urinary bladder is:
questions.explanation: Urothelium stretches as the bladder fills.

questions.stem: Ductless glands releasing chemical messengers directly into blood capillaries are:
questions.explanation: Endocrine glands are ductless glands secreting hormones.

questions.stem: Which cell junction prevents leakage of digestive fluids across epithelial cell sheets?
questions.explanation: Tight junctions seal cell membranes to block fluid leakage.
